🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
CAUTION, Style mixed / no clear leadership. Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive. Confirmation: extremely weak sector breadth plus narrow leadership concentrated in Technology (top performers), while Financials, Industrials and Materials show broad weakness.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Technology leads: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND. Consumer Staples showing isolated strength via TGT (1W: +6.16% | 1M: +9.48%) ABOVE TREND and Consumer Discretionary via BKNG (1W: +6.48% | 1M: +0.17%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Materials, Industrials and Financials are the weakest on 1W performance. Examples: LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND, UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND.

📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND; DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND; SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND; NOW (1W: +11.43% | 1M: +18.81%) ABOVE TREND; PANW (1W: +9.96% | 1M: +6.67%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology).

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND; FCX (1W: -11.42% | 1M: +2.14%) CORRECTION; BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND; PPG (1W: -9.19% | 1M: -12.50%) BELOW TREND; CRH (1W: -9.25% | 1M: -12.26%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in Materials/Industrials/Financials.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Strongest 1W movers: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, DOW (1W: +12.12% | 1M: +13.45%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence across large caps (≥3 majors with opposing 1W vs 1M: AMAT CORRECTION, FCX CORRECTION, CAT CORRECTION) — suppress strong regime calls and watch for trend breaks.

🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed but technically the only positive sector on 1W; Tech breadth is the lone positive sector (24 stocks total) in a weak market. Keys: MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND, NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND, AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) BELOW TREND, AMAT (1W: -8.93% | 1M: +11.64%) CORRECTION.

8. Financials Outlook?
Financials are weak on 1W with broad negative internals. Examples: JPM (1W: -2.57% | 1M: -6.53%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND, V (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -3.80%) BELOW TREND.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Healthcare shows distribution with mixed micro-cycles and several 1W/1M divergences. JNJ (1W: -2.40% | 1M: +2.56%) CORRECTION, UNH (1W: -3.31% | 1M: +6.19%) CORRECTION, LLY (1W: -0.94% | 1M: -1.05%) BELOW TREND.

🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
Favor selective exposure to the handful of Technology leaders showing ABOVE TREND strength (INTU, SHOP, AVGO, NOW) and TGT in Staples; reduce exposure to broadly weak Financials and Materials names showing BELOW TREND. Style mixed / no clear leadership — stay selective and monitor the MAJOR divergence for confirmation before adding cyclical exposure.

🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, SHOP (1W: +11.83% | 1M: +20.01%) ABOVE TREND, AVGO (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND — watch follow-through. BEARISH: UPS (1W: -12.66% | 1M: -13.06%) BELOW TREND, BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -8.48% | 1M: -0.89%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Technology (only sector positive on 1W; watch whether leadership widens beyond narrow names). BEARISH: Materials, Industrials, Financials — watch for further downside if breadth doesn't improve (Breadth: 1/11 sectors positive).

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
Watch whether NVDA (1W: +0.09% | 1M: +6.27%) ABOVE TREND can sustain recent 1M gains for a broader Tech lift; MSFT (1W: +2.72% | 1M: +4.24%) ABOVE TREND holding weekly support would confirm tech carry; BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND reclaiming weekly range would be needed to diminish Financial risk.

📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
AVGO (+55): Broadcom 2nm SoC headline — AVGO (1W: +8.45% | 1M: +11.35%) ABOVE TREND, sentiment confirming price strength. GOOGL (+50): Alphabet powering AI healthcare — GOOGL (1W: -0.05% | 1M: -7.51%) BELOW TREND, sentiment is a potential catalyst but price is diverging (distribution risk).

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BLK (-60): BlackRock story — BLK (1W: -9.86% | 1M: -8.70%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirms weakness. AAPL (-50): regulatory headline — AAPL (1W: -1.83% | 1M: -5.72%) BELOW TREND, sentiment aligns with underperformance. INTU (-55): price target cut — INTU (1W: +13.03% | 1M: +8.91%) ABOVE TREND, bearish headline diverges from strong price action (watch for distribution).

📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

CAUTION, Style mixed / no clear leadership. INTU, SHOP, AVGO showing relative strength (ABOVE TREND) while large-cap Financials and Materials are broadly BELOW TREND. Key risk: extreme breadth weakness (1/11 sectors positive) and MAJOR divergences between news sentiment and price (e.g., INTU negative headlines vs strong gains) — watch for trend confirmation.
